classification.difficultyReason: Infer that the unlabelled horizontal and vertical boundary segments total the full width and height, derive 10x without individual lengths, then solve.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the perimeter of the figure shown below in terms of $x$. (All angles are right angles.)

spec.description: Unfilled six-sided rectilinear step figure with bottom width labelled 3x cm and full right height labelled 2x cm. Drawing coordinates establish appearance only; unlabelled lengths are not givens. Ordinary source-blue strokes are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: The two upper horizontal boundary segments total 3x cm. The two left vertical boundary segments total 2x cm. All angles are right angles.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens are visible; no missing lengths or perimeter are supplied.

answer.short:
$10x\text{ cm}$.

The upper horizontal sides total $3x\text{ cm}$ and the left vertical sides total $2x\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
The upper horizontal sides together equal the bottom width, $3x\text{ cm}$. The left vertical sides together equal the right height, $2x\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}P&=3x+2x+3x+2x\\P&=10x\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
